summary: ArcRho now starts on an automatically chosen free local port when its default port is held by another user session on the same machine.
details: Startup previously failed with 'App server process exited before readiness (code=3)' when another Windows user's ArcRho session already occupied local port 28765.

The desktop app publishes its effective local endpoint to a per-user AppData discovery file, and the Python API and standalone Arcode macro bridge resolve that file automatically when no explicit URL override is set.
